meals.name: All day breakfast
meals.notes: Grilled bacon and tomatoes, mushrooms, baked beans and a fried egg.

macros.note: Assumed 2 rashers grilled bacon, 1 fried egg, grilled tomatoes and mushrooms, and half a tin of baked beans.

meals.name: BBQ chicken skewers and salad
meals.notes: Chicken, pepper and onion skewers in a barbecue marinade, with a big salad.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the ingredients. The NHS link is the same skewer with jerk seasoning and a corn cobette instead of salad; barbecue sauce carries more sugar than dry jerk seasoning, which is where the extra carbohydrate comes from. meals.name: Beef lasagne
meals.notes: Classic ragu with pancetta and a proper bechamel, topped with mozzarella and parmesan.

macros.note: Published figure | olive magazine published figures, per serving. This is a rich version - noticeably heavier than the NHS recipes here.

ingredients.note: 100ml for the ragu, 850ml for the bechamel

meals.name: Chicken and chorizo jambalaya
meals.notes: One-pan rice dish: chicken breast, chorizo, onion, red pepper and Cajun spice, simmered with plum tomatoes and stock. Serves 4.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Worked out from the ingredient list you gave, divided by 4. Assumes 2 x 175g raw chicken breasts and cured chorizo. BBC Good Food's own figures could not be checked.

meals.name: Chicken breast, new potatoes and vegetables
meals.notes: Plain roast or grilled chicken breast with boiled new potatoes, broccoli and carrots.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the ingredients. The NHS link is a close relative (it uses baking potatoes and peppers), so its published 384kcal is a useful sanity check - almost identical.  Picture: Photo is the NHS version with peppers and a baking potato, not new potatoes.

meals.name: Chicken burger, salad and corn on the cob
meals.notes: Grilled chicken breast in a bun with salad, and a corn cobette each.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the ingredients. The NHS link is their turkey-mince burger, which is a different thing - a whole chicken breast in the bun makes this higher in protein than their 354kcal version.  Picture: Photo is the NHS turkey-mince burger, not a whole chicken breast.

meals.name: Chicken caesar salad with croutons
meals.notes: Grilled chicken over cos lettuce with croutons, parmesan and a light caesar dressing.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the ingredients, assuming a reduced-fat dressing. A shop-bought full-fat caesar dressing would add roughly 100kcal per serving on its own.

meals.name: Chicken curry
meals.notes: Bengali-style chicken curry with green peppers, served with basmati rice.

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures, per 1/4 recipe, including the rice.

meals.name: Chicken fajitas
meals.notes: Chicken strips with peppers and onion, fajita spice, two tortillas and soured cream.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | My estimate - no NHS fajita recipe exists. Assumes 150g chicken, two flour tortillas and a spoon of soured cream each. The link is the nearest NHS chicken wrap, which is a cold lunch rather than hot fajitas.

meals.name: Chicken jalfrezi
meals.notes: Chicken, peppers, onion and tomato in a spiced sauce. Serve with rice or chapatis.

macros.note: Published figure | NHS figures, per 1/4 recipe, curry only (rice extra). Their page lists '79g fat', which is a typo - fat here is derived from the calorie total.

meals.name: Chicken parmigiana
meals.notes: Breaded chicken breast baked under tomato sauce and mozzarella.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | My own calculation from the ingredients - no NHS recipe exists for this one, so there is no published figure to check it against. Assumes oven-baked, not fried.

meals.name: Chicken stir-fry and noodles
meals.notes: Chicken strips and crunchy vegetables in a light soy and orange sauce, with egg noodles.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the ingredients. The NHS link is the identical recipe made with turkey (301kcal) - chicken breast is slightly leaner, which is the whole of the difference.  Picture: Photo is the NHS turkey stir-fry - same dish made with turkey.

meals.name: Chickpea curry and rice
meals.notes: Chickpeas simmered in a spiced tomato and coconut sauce with spinach, served with basmati.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the ingredients. The NHS link is the same style of curry with kidney beans instead of chickpeas (446kcal); the coconut milk and the larger rice portion here account for most of the difference.  Picture: Photo is the NHS kidney bean curry, not chickpea.

meals.name: Falafel wraps and salad
meals.notes: Baked chickpea falafel in wraps with lettuce, tomato, cucumber and yoghurt.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the NHS ingredients but with wraps instead of their pitta. Good corroboration: the NHS publishes 371kcal for the pitta version and my method gives 378 for the wrap version - a 2% gap, which is what you would expect from the swap.

meals.name: Fish pie
meals.notes: White fish in parsley sauce with peas, under mashed potato and a little cheddar.

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures, per 1/4 recipe.

meals.name: Grilled chicken breast with white rice and broccolini
meals.notes:
one chicken breast per person, 75g uncooked rice per person, half a pack of tenderstem broccoli per person. 
Add spices and cook in butter to create a simple sauce to moisten the meal.

macros.note: Source not recorded | This meal predates the sourcing convention and its figures have no recorded origin, so treat them with more caution than the rest. The ingredient list does support roughly this calorie count.

ingredients.note: for cooking the chicken and broccoli

meals.name: Jacket potato, tuna and mayonnaise
meals.notes: Baked potatoes filled with tuna mayonnaise, with a green side salad.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Worked out from the ingredients, per serving. The NHS link is their tuna-and-BEAN jacket - the method is the same but this version is tuna mayonnaise, so the figures are mine, not theirs.  Picture: Photo is the NHS tuna-and-bean jacket, not tuna mayonnaise.

meals.name: Pasta bake and salad
meals.notes: Macaroni baked with courgette, tomato and green beans under a cheese crust, with a side salad.

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures for the bake (293kcal), plus my calculation for the side salad (about 14kcal). Two sources added together, which is why it is not a round NHS number.

meals.name: Pasta chopped salad
meals.notes: Cold pasta with chopped tomato, cucumber, spring onion and cheese, on crisp lettuce.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Deliberately NOT the NHS published figure. Their page states 16g carbohydrate per serving, but 50g of dried pasta per serving contributes 35g of carbohydrate on its own, so their number cannot be right. These are my figures from their ingredient list.

meals.name: Pasta with tomato sauce and chicken
meals.notes: NHS tomato sauce and spaghetti, with a grilled chicken breast added per person.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | NHS published figures for the pasta and sauce (343 kcal), plus 150g raw chicken breast per person (about 165 kcal, 31g protein) added by me.

meals.name: Pesto pasta with cheddar
meals.notes: Pasta stirred through green pesto with grated cheddar. About as fast as dinner gets.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the ingredients using standard (not reduced-fat) pesto. The NHS link is a vegetable-loaded version at 393kcal - the gap is mostly the pesto and the cheddar, so switching to reduced-fat pesto would bring this down a long way.  Picture: Photo is the NHS version loaded with roast squash and peppers.

meals.name: Pork steak, carrot and swede, new potatoes
meals.notes: Pork loin steak with carrot and swede mash and boiled new potatoes.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | My estimate - the NHS pork recipe uses different sides. Assumes a 150g pork loin steak, 200g new potatoes and 150g carrot and swede mash each.

meals.name: Puff pastry pizzas
meals.notes:
Easy rough chopped puff pastry pizza. 
Add sweetcorn, olives peppers, a side salad etc

meals.name: Roast dinner

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures, per serving, recipe serves 6 with 150g chicken each, no skin.

meals.name: Roast potatoes with beef and onion mix
meals.notes: Cubed potatoes roasted crisp, with a savoury beef and onion mince mix spooned over.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | Calculated from the ingredients. The NHS link is the same mince mix on a baked potato; roasting cubed potatoes in oil is what pushes the fat and calories above their 306kcal.  Picture: Photo is the NHS baked potato with mince, not roasted cubed potatoes.

meals.name: Salmon
meals.notes: Pan-fried salmon fillets with spring onion mash and broccoli.

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures for salmon with spring onion mash, per 1/4 recipe.

meals.name: Spaghetti bolognese

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures, per 1/4 recipe, including the spaghetti.

meals.name: Speedy pizza
meals.notes: Wholemeal pitta bases with tomato puree, veg and a little cheese. Grilled in 5 minutes.

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures, per 1/4 recipe (one pitta each).

macros.note: Calculated estimate | My calculation from the Second Nature ingredient list - that site publishes no nutrition figures. Recipe serves 2. Green vegetables included, no potatoes or rice.

meals.name: Steak pie and chips
meals.notes: One ASDA Rich Steak & Gravy pie plus 150g of frozen straight-cut chips per person. Pie: oven 200C fan / gas 6, 30-35 mins. Chips: oven 220C / fan 200C / gas 7, 20-22 mins. Both from frozen.

macros.note: Published figures | Added up from both ASDA pack labels: one pie (313 kcal) plus 150g frozen chips, which the pack says cooks down to about 100g (165 kcal). Both oven-baked.

meals.name: Stuffed peppers

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures, per 1/4 recipe.

macros.note: Published figure | NHS published figures, per 1/4 recipe. Their page uses penne and says any pasta shape is fine, so tagliatelle does not change the numbers.

meals.name: Teriyaki chicken and jasmine rice
meals.notes: Teriyaki chicken with stir-fried vegetables and jasmine rice.

macros.note: Calculated estimate | My estimate - no NHS teriyaki recipe exists. Assumes 150g chicken, 75g dry rice and 2 tbsp teriyaki sauce each. The link is the nearest NHS chicken stir-fry.

meals.name: Turkey chilli
